description: Search ZipRecruiter by keyword and location, or paste search and job URLs. Returns each job's full description plus salary, company, location, workplace and apply details.

companyName.description: Only jobs from one company, e.g. `Visa`. The name is resolved on ZipRecruiter. Leave Search queries empty to browse all of the company's jobs.
companyName.title: Company name

daysPosted.description: Only jobs posted within the last N days. 0 = any time.
daysPosted.title: Posted within (days)

experienceLevels.description: Restrict to one or more seniority levels. Empty = no filter.
experienceLevels.title: Experience levels

fetchDescriptions.description: When on (recommended), each job's detail data and full description are fetched — the actor's core feature. Turn off for faster, cheaper runs with search-card fields only.
fetchDescriptions.title: Fetch full descriptions

jobType.description: Employment-type filter, applied to keyword searches.
jobType.title: Job type

locations.description: Cities, states or `United States` for a national search. Leave empty to search the whole United States. Every query is searched in every location.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job postings to return across all searches.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxSearches.description: Cap on the number of query × location combinations when using Search queries (each combination is one search).
maxSearches.title: Max searches

quickApplyOnly.description: Only jobs that can be applied to on ZipRecruiter with 1-Click Apply.
quickApplyOnly.title: 1-Click Apply only

radiusMiles.description: Distance around the location. 0 = ZipRecruiter's default.
radiusMiles.title: Search radius (miles)

remoteOnly.description: Kept for older tasks: same as setting Workplace type to `Remote`.
remoteOnly.title: Remote only (legacy)

salaryMax.description: Upper bound of the pay range: only jobs whose advertised annual pay stays at or below this amount. 0 = no upper bound.
salaryMax.title: Maximum salary (annual USD)

salaryMin.description: Lower bound of the pay range: only jobs whose advertised annual pay reaches at least this amount. 0 = no lower bound.
salaryMin.title: Minimum salary (annual USD)

searchQueries.description: Job keywords to search, e.g. `registered nurse`, `software engineer`. Every query is searched in every location below.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

startUrls.description: ZipRecruiter search URLs (filters in the URL are honored, e.g. `https://www.ziprecruiter.com/jobs-search?search=software+engineer&location=New+York%2C+NY`) or individual job links like `https://www.ziprecruiter.com/c/Company/Job/Title/-in-City,ST?jid=...`.
startUrls.title: ZipRecruiter URLs

workplace.description: Work-arrangement filter (remote includes jobs that offer a remote option).
workplace.title: Workplace type

title: ZipRecruiter Jobs with Full Description Extractor Input
